lastTask: Implement Track D5 autonomous evolving performance

projectState.summary: Track D5 is implemented on codex/byte-d5-evolving-performance. Evolution now supports a bounded 500-generation cap plus startGenerationIndex for timer-batched runs. The new default-off window.prosody.performEvolvingElite() driver evolves phrase candidates in batches, auditions the current best through the existing D2 melody override, and swaps only to strictly higher-fitness elites; stopEvolvingElite() cancels the timer and clears the audition override. The cycle normalizes aggregate fitness to the four-decimal precision persisted by the server before comparing/scoring, closing a repeated-run rescoring bug. Validation: build green, smoke 68/68, db:smoke green, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
